palettes.dmg_gray: Four DMG shades as 8-bit gray: $FF, $AA, $55, $00 (lightest to darkest), per the mealybug and c-sp READMEs.
palettes.cgb_rgb555: CGB colors: each 5-bit channel x becomes (x << 3) | (x >> 2).
palettes.cgb_compat_csp: A DMG-only ROM on CGB: the CGB boot ROM's compatibility palette, which c-sp lists as BG #000000 #0063C6 #7BFF31 #FFFFFF and OBJ #000000 #943939 #FF8484 #FFFFFF (8-bit RGB). Depends on which boot ROM runs.
